name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Generate
description: Admin generates the Acuerdo de Confidencialidad (NDA) PDF from the Documentos tab of the diagnostic edit page. Section displays 'No generado' with a 'Generar acuerdo' CTA when no NDA exists. CTA opens ConfidentialityParamsModal with 13 fields (cliente: nombre/NIT/representante/email; consultor: nombre/NIT/cédula/email — defaults to Project App SAS / team@projectapp.co; acuerdo: ciudad — default Medellín, día/mes/año, cláusula penal — default 50 SMMLV). The consultor must be identified by NIT or cédula — at least one is required client-side and by ConfidentialityParamsSerializer; the NIT wins when both are present. Submit posts to POST /api/diagnostics/:id/confidentiality/params/, which validates via ConfidentialityParamsSerializer, persists to diagnostic.confidentiality_params, and creates a DiagnosticAttachment with document_type='confidentiality_agreement' and is_generated=true. Section then shows 'Generado el {fecha}' with Descargar / Borrador / Editar parámetros buttons.
